title: The Little Boat That Sailed Home
menuLabel: the little boat that sailed home

pages.text: There was once a little blue boat who worked far away, on a sea so wide you could not see the other side.
One night the wind came up and the waves grew tall, and the little boat held on tight and thought of home.
When the storm passed, the stars came out, and every single one of them was pointing the same way.
So the little boat sailed home, all night, until the harbour lights were shining. Goodnight, {child}.
